newsitem.title: USA: Conn Rowland's has $1 mln of campaign funds--paper.
newsitem.headline: Conn Rowland's has $1 mln of campaign funds--paper.

text.p: Connecticut's Governor John Rowland has raised more $1 million for a re-election effort that has not officially begun, with over half the sum raised in the past three months, the Hartford Courant said Friday.

Much of the recent contributions were made by construction companies, lawyers and others doing business with the state, along with at least a dozen commissioners and other high-ranking employees, the paper said, citing a report.
Rowland has yet to declare himself as an official candidate for next year's race but the paper quoted his spokesman as saying he was moving in that direction.

The only Democrat to have raised more than $100,000 so far is New Haven real estate broker John Nussbaum, who has never run for public office. The two major announced Democratic candidates, Bill Curry from Farmington, who ran against Rowland in 1994, and House Speaker Thomas Ritter from Hartford, each have raised less than $1,000 with newly formed gubernatorial candidate committees, the paper said.
